completion_reason: Three material workflow-experience decisions remain unresolved: landing behavior, approval handling, and queue configuration feedback.

questions.label: Default landing
questions.context: The six tabs have distinct purposes, but the operator’s starting point is undefined.
questions.question: What should NexusCentral show first when opened?

choices.text: Work tab with recent conversations and one primary start control
Runs tab with current operational status and recent evidence
Restore the last-opened tab and view
Compact cross-tab dashboard before entering a tab

questions.label: Approval handling
questions.context: Approval-gated stages need a clear operational path without weakening immutable run evidence.
questions.question: Where should pending approvals be handled?

choices.text: Runs tab inbox with evidence summary and explicit approve or reject controls
Inside each Workflow with approval status mirrored in Runs
Global notification tray linking to the relevant run

questions.label: Router feedback
questions.context: Drag-configured queue groups need to communicate eligibility and routing consequences before changes take effect.
questions.question: How should Router configuration changes become active?

choices.text: Draft changes with inline validation, then explicit Apply
Apply each valid drag immediately with undo
Save the entire Router configuration as a new version
Require a preview simulation before every apply
